children: rose 0.78% premarket after JPMorgan upgraded it to overweight from neutral and raised its December 2027 price target to $820 from $640, implying more than 25% upside. The average target across analysts sits near $750. Analyst Doug Anmuth pointed to Muse, the AI agent Meta launched this week, which hit third in the US app store on its second day with early usage running at 10x the training cohorts.

Anmuth wrote that Meta is "well-positioned to deliver consumer-driven AI products to its base of ~4B users, and that scaled distribution is a significant competitive advantage." He expects the rebound to continue, with the company still early in releasing frontier models and AI products beyond advertising.

The stock is up 20% from an August low, helped by settling social-media trials last month, and gained 6.6% on Wednesday as analysts responded to Muse. After this upgrade, more than 90% of analysts tracked by Bloomberg rate Meta a buy, with the rest at hold and none at sell.

title: JPMorgan Lifts Meta to $820 as Muse Reaches Number Three
